title: Disco Muse in Ruins
description: A woman covered entirely in reflective silver mirrorball tiles stands dramatically on mossy stone stairs, her right arm raised with one finger pointing upward. She wears a vibrant crown of green leaves and blue flowers, with two birds flying near her head, set against a dark cosmic background filled with glowing orbs and light beams.
prompt: A woman completely covered in small reflective silver disco ball mirror tiles stands on crumbling moss-covered stone stairs in a surreal cosmic landscape. She wears a lush crown of green leaves and blue flowers, one arm raised high with index finger pointing up. Two birds fly near her head. Behind her are broken classical ruins draped in fabric, a floating bowler hat, a floating ring, and a large ornate picture frame showing a glowing forest path. Dramatic god rays pierce through a dark starry sky filled with glowing green orbs.
